content.text: The error is because `BasedOnStyle: Linux` doesn't exist — clang-format has no built-in "Linux" style (I was wrong to assume that shortcut existed). The actual Linux kernel `.clang-format` is a full explicit config, not `BasedOnStyle: Linux`.
